audit.scope: blind adversarial audit of CONSUMER/INTEGRATION seams - every place persisted/restored state is consumed by the beta scope contract
audit.probe_results: 29/29 pass on the pinned state; npm run type-check clean
audit.defect_definition: dormant scope leaking into visible play through a consumer path, OR a gated record still minting effects downstream of the boundary (flagged saves must still LOAD)

verdict.label: PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE
verdict.summary: Every consumer seam attacked at a7d12edf fails closed: dormant kits, formations, companions, hidden beasts, hidden mechanics (Quan The, Nghich Chu Tian, ancient beast trial, hidden tribulation outcomes), dormant talents, dormant passives/skills/techniques, alchemy/decompose/worker production, daily quests, vendor, building writes, way selection, and all tri-state read models. Carried dormant records deserialize inert; flagged saves still load via unsupportedReleaseReason flagging (not blocking).

findings.surface: src/core/game/CombatBuild.ts:385-387 - survive.extraSources binds runtime.buildSurviveSources from the UNGATED runtime (not gatedRuntime)
findings.repro: None possible at a7d12edf: no runtime in CULTIVATION_PATH_MODULES defines buildSurviveSources (grep-verified: only the type declaration at src/core/player/CultivationPathRuntime.ts:52 and the parked-content comment at src/core/player/CultivationPathRegistry.ts:495). Probe 'emits nothing from any dormant channel' asserts build.survive.extraSources === undefined on a dormant-way save - passes.
findings.mint_path: CombatBuild.ts:385 resolveCombatBuild emits survive.extraSources bound from `runtime` while every sibling channel (kit, formation, aura, tranPhap buffs, companions) is evaluated against wayAdmitted/isScopeHidden. If a post-beta way runtime gains buildSurviveSources on a way that is dormant under the beta allow-list, a carried way_out_of_scope save mints SurviveLethalSource entries downstream at GameManagerTurnBattleOps.ts:1894 (`build.survive.extraSources?.(...)`) - bypassing the way gate every sibling respects.
findings.recommendation: When any runtime gains buildSurviveSources, gate this binding with the same wayAdmitted predicate used for capabilities/formationBuff (line ~347) or bind from gatedRuntime.
